An & that would read as a character reference in a link destination or title stays literal

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<a href=\"?&amp;plus;\" title=\"&amp;plus;\">T</a>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
